metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for development workflow

plugins.name: task-tracker
plugins.description: Lightweight task/ticket tracker using TSV files and shell scripts

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Guides creation and review of Claude Code Agent Skills with standardized workflows and quality checklists, with a skill-review Custom SubAgent that audits skills in an isolated context and returns a read-only findings report

plugins.name: checking-oss-release
plugins.description: Checks open source projects for security leaks, privacy issues, and license compliance before release

plugins.name: designing-test-cases
plugins.description: Guides systematic test case design using established testing techniques

plugins.name: wsl-notify
plugins.description: Windows desktop notifications and sleep inhibition for Claude Code via wsl-relay — alerts on task completion and permission prompts, keeps the host awake while tasks run

plugins.name: hardening-dev-environment
plugins.description: Hardens Claude Code dev environments: pnpm supply-chain config + npx-to-pnpm-dlx migration; mode-agnostic .claude/settings.json deny/ask rules and v2.1.83+ auto-mode overlay (defaultMode + classifier backstops); PreToolUse hooks (credential reads, package.json scripts tampering); PostToolUse trust-boundary reminder for non-vendor WebFetch results

plugins.name: docs-authoring
plugins.description: Guides writing and tightening engineering documents (design docs, tickets) in the main session, with a docs-review Custom SubAgent that audits documents in an isolated context and returns a read-only findings report

plugins.name: ticket-authoring
plugins.description: Guides filing tickets as user stories that keep purpose in charge of means, with a ticket-review Custom SubAgent that audits a ticket's premises in an isolated context and returns a read-only findings report

plugins.name: gnome-loop
plugins.description: Development pipeline plugin. The dev-cycle skill carries the six-stage development method any session follows from ticket filing to close; the gnome-loop skill runs autonomous laps over loop-ready tickets (worktree implementation, review, evidence, merge queue) with a bundled implementer agent for novel-lane work; the onboarding skill wires a new host project in one conversation.

plugins.name: decision-queue
plugins.description: Keeps the decisions awaiting the user always visible in the statusline — one queue file per session, updated by Claude as items arise and resolve, surviving plugin updates via a self-healing stable path
